    TRANSFER_VOL = 40        # µL per transfer (80% of 50 µL tip capacity, safe headroom)
    N_COLUMNS = 12           # serial dilution spans columns 1 -> 12
    MIX_CYCLES = 3           # mix cycles to homogenize before each serial transfer
    N_CHANNELS = 8           # channels addressed per column (rows A-H)

    if TRANSFER_VOL > 50:

    col_vols = [TRANSFER_VOL] * N_CHANNELS

    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------
